profile.headline: Masters in Mechanical Engineering at Virginia Tech

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Working as a Software Test and Validation engineer for Dynamics Testing and Verification products pertaining to MathWorks to minimize market bugs and ensuring highest quality products released for the users.

- Responsible for testing and enhancing software for the internal infrastructure of testing and logging products at Mathworks.

- Developing internal tools to improve development and testing processes for releasing high quality products.

- Responsible for testing and enhancing Logging tools like scope, Data Inspector, Jetstream, Real Time logging etc.

positions.title: Engineer in Engineering Development Group
positions.description:
- Working with the Simscape Multibody team to develop the Simscape Multibody Toolbox. Majorly working on full feature development (Design, Implementation and Unit Testing) for enhancing the toolbox. Using C++ to develop and unit test the features. Worked on development of various force blocks and joint blocks in the Simscape multibody library

- Contributed to the Computer Vision and Automated Driving Toolbox team to develop a VSLAM feature for breaking down every image in the database to Bag of Words. This improved the efficiency of loop closure in the VSLAM applications

- Developed an example to use Extremum Seeking Control for Battery State of Charge Estimation using the Control Systems Toolbox and Simscape Battery.

- Also serving part time as an Application Support Engineer to help Simulink and other MathWorks Engineering products' users with Technical issues regarding the usage of the products. This role provides me opportunities to show leadership while working in a collaborative environment. I contribute as a Tech Coach or Operations Lead to lead the Support Team tackle customers' technical issues. Developed a thorough understanding of Simulink and other engineering products like Simscape, Robotics Toolbox, Requirements Toolbox etc.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Fall 22 semester: GTA for ME 2004 - Engineering Analysis and Numerical Methods using MATLAB. ME 2004 is a sophomore level course and my tasks involved conducting office hours, leading recitation classes, making homeworks, and grading of homeworks.

Spring 23 semester: GTA for ME 3414 - Fluid Dynamics lab. Tasks include supervising the lab sessions and grading of the lab reports.
positions.insights: Skills: Fluid Dynamics · Design of Experiments (DOE) · Teaching · Numerical Analysis · MATLAB

positions.title: Engineering Development Group Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a software development intern at Mathworks with the Stateflow development team.

Worked on problems of graph traversal and developed a feature for converting any Stateflow graph to a Direct Acyclic Graph.

Created a class for DFS traversal of any Stateflow model to return various properties of the graph using Visitor Pattern Design.

Used C++ as the programming language and Stateflow for testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Graph Algorithms · Data Structures · C++ · Software Development

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
GTA for Sophomore level course ME2004 - Engineering Analysis and Numerical Methods.
My responsibilities include conducting weekly MATLAB doubt solving sessions, setting-up assignments, and grading of assignments/tests.

positions.title: Visiting Researcher
positions.description: Worked on a Passive Battery Thermal Management System for Electric Vehicles by embedding Li-ion cells into high porosity metal foam. Analyzed the heat transfer rate and temperature uniformity of the battery pack. Established a correlation between Nusselt and Rayleigh number on the surface of Porous Media.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Worked as a product engineering intern at the Modular Fabrication Facility of L&T Hydrocarbon Engineering, Hazira Manufacturing Complex, Surat. The project I assisted on was the fabrication of pressure vessel for IOCL Bongaigaon.

positions.title: Winter Intern
positions.description: All the interns were trained with the industrial processes and chain of processes and sequence of an I.C. Engine manufacturing and the market trends and technologies of motorbike engineering. My team was given a project to develop a 2 door sports coupe for Indian market under Rs 60 Lakhs with safety, performance and emission control as key problems. Got the award of "Best Intern" amongst 80 interns.

projects.title: MPC & PID Controllers
projects.description: Different control algorithms for Lane change maneuver of autonomous vehicles. Used python as the programming language and a linear bicycle model for state-space equations,
